24 July
On this day in 1954

Baba Gurdit Singh, leader of Koma-Gata Maru passed away

Also on this day

  • 1985A written agreement took place between the President of the Shiromani Akali Dal, Harchand Singh Longowal and the Prime Minister of India, Rajiv Gandhi This agreement is known as the Rajiv-Longowal Accord.
